tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po beng chen lcam dral las bdag pho mo dang bcas pa'i par bu nag po'i sgrub thabs gnam lcags thog mda' zhes bya ba bzhugs so/
༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po beng chen lcam dral las bdag pho mo dang bcas pa'i par bu nag po'i sgrub thabs gnam lcags thog mda' zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po beng chen lcam dral las bdag pho mo dang bcas pa'i par bu nag po'i sgrub thabs gnam lcags thog mda' zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mchog dus kyi lha la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin chos dbyings zhi khyab sdang dang khro ba kun bral yang*// gdug pa 'dul phyir snying rje'i rnam rol sgyu 'phrul drag po'i zlos gar gyis/ bdud dang bdud kyi 'jigs pa kun 'joms thub bstan srung dang rgyas mdzad pa// ye shes khro chen longs sprul sku lnga gang yin de la bdag 'dud do// thub bstan padmo rgyas pa dang*// de yi nyer 'tshe zhi ba'i thabs| |phrin las gnamalcags thog gi mda'// ma rungs snying la kho bos bsnun// dbang thob cing dam tshig la legs par gnas pas/ yi dam dang chos skyong la bsnyen pa rtags ldan thems pa'i sngags pa rang don yid byed kyi dri ma dang bral bas/ dpal ldan bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba sogs zhing bcu tshang ba'i gdug pa can rnams zhi ba'i thabs kyis bzlog par ma gyur na/ ma rungs pa de'i las ngan rgyun gcod cing*/ go 'phang dam pa la dgod par 'dod pa rgyu dus kyi kun slong snying rje chen po las ma g.yos bzhin du/ bla ma dang bstan la gnod pa de nyid skad cig la tshar gcod pa de dus kyi kun slong zhe sdang drag pos mtshams sbyar te/ beng chen mgon po'i sgo nas phrin las drag po'i par bu nag po gnam lcags thog mda' nyamasu blang ba la gsum/ sbyor ba sngon 'gro ba/ dngos gzhi nyams su blang ba/ mjug mtha' rgyas kyi bsdu ba'o// dang po sbyor ba sngon du 'gro ba la'ang gnas/ dus/ gang zag /yo byad/ dkyil 'khor/ par bu bsham pa'i tshul/rten bca' ba rnams so// dngos gzhi gnas ni/ dur khrod/ g.yul bkyes pa'i shul lam/ grong khyer phung ba'i shul lam/ sde brgyad drag po gnas pa'i sa'am/ chos 'khor rnying pa la sogs pa drag cing gdug rtsub dang ldan pa'i sa/ dben zhing 'tshe dogs med pa'i gnas rnams su'o// dus ni lo nag po'am/ gzas po de'i lo skeg gam/ bdun zur la bab pa/ zla ba yang de dang 'dra bar zla nag gam/

gzas po'i skag dang bdun zur la bab pa dang*/ yang na gzas po na shi dur dgu gang rung du tshud pa sogs rig pas gzhal bar bya'o// gang zag ni/ sngar bshad pa lta bu'i steng du snying rje che ba/ dpa' zhing brtul phod pa/ sran thub cing bzod pa dang ldan pa/ snying stobs che zhing brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/ sgrub grogs kyang de lta bu dang ldan pa ci rigs pa rnams so// yo byad ni/ phyi rten rta lug g.yag nag po gang 'dzom/ nang rten gos nag /dar nag /thod pa nag po/ gsang rten mda' rgod sgro ma byas par/ gri lcags kyi mde'u dang*/ gri rgyus kyis bcings pa/ skyes dar ma grir shi ba'i snying srog rtsa ma nyams pa/ byang sems dkar dmar/ bla rdo/ ming po'i thun rdzas/ dge slong rdul med pa'i snam sbyar/ chos gos/ 'khar gsil/ mda' rgod sgro ma/ dar nag /sring mo'i thun rdzas/ bal mo'i phuu dung gnyis ka'am ya ba/ lcags phur ram mchog chen gyi phur pa/ bsil thun ma mgon gnyis kyi tsaka li/ yungs dkar nag /gri lcags dang mtshon cha sna tshogs pa'i phye ma/ mi'am phyugs bsad pa'i rbab rdo rnams phye mar byas pa dug chus sbol ba rnams so// mchod pa'i rdzas/ nas/ 'bras/ gro/ sran ma/ so ba/ yungs kar/ bra bo/ ram pa/ til nag rnams kyi rjen phye/ rin po che sna tshogs/ phyugs chen gyi sha rus khrag /a mṛ ta/ gu gul/ zhun chen/ rkang gling*/ thod rnga la sogs pa'i rol mo du ma/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rab gnas dang ldan pa/ spang skong phyag rgya pa'am/ 'jam sdud smon gsum gyi glegs bam/ gzhan yang nye bar mkho ba'i bza' bca'/ nad sel gyi sman/ rkyen zlog gi mtshon cha la sogs pa mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad sgrub khongs su brel g.yeng mi dgos pa ci dgos 'dzom par bsag go| |dkyil 'khor bca' ba ni/ sngar bshad pa'i gnas de rnams gang yang rung bar phyag dar legs par byas te/ gnas khang de'i dbus su drang por/ phung sa sna tshogs las byas pa'i stegs bu'i rgya khru gsum mam do ste gnas khang yangs dog la dpag pa|

dpangs su khru phyed do yod pa kha bad dang bcas pa sra zhing 'jam par byas pa'i dbus su par khang gru gsum pa/ zur gcig lhor bstan pa/ dpangs su khru phyed stegs bu la brus shing*/ khru phyed steng du brtsigs pa/ de yang stan rgyal steng nas mdzug gang gi sar/ lhung bzed shong nges pa la kha khyer dang bcas pa/ de'i 'og bang rim nang du btsud de bskum pa'i rgyar mtho gang tsam yod pa/ dug sna/ khrag sna/ snying sna sbyar bas dmar po/ phyi ro sol/ rgya sol/ rdo nag gi phye ma khrag rlon dang sbyar nas nag por byug go// par bu ni gzhung rnying pa rnams su phyi'i par bu rdzas las byas pa/ nang gi par bu lcags las byas pa/ gsang ba'i par bu rabs chad nag po'i thod pa zhes gsungs kyang*/ da lta lag len du dge slong khrims ldan gyi lhung bzed la bya'o// dur rdo phur pa'i dbyibs can mtho gang tsam pa gsum/ gzhan yang phung shul/ ro bsregs/ g.yul bkyes gsum gyi sar khams sa bzang po dang bsres pa'i mchod rten zur gsum pa sor gsum re ba bang rim gnyis pa/ de'i steng bum stan mtheb sor gang pa/ de'i steng bum pa sor dgu/ de'i steng bre dang bre gdan sbrags pa sor do yod pa/ bang rim 'og ma'i rgyar mkhyud gang pa de yan ci rigs su byas pa la/ gri lcags dang mtshon cha sna tshogs pa'i rtse mo brdar ba'i phye ma/ thog mde'u/ mi phyugs bsad pa'i rbab rdo rnams phye mar byas la/ dug sna ro sol rnams gri khrag dang sbyar nas nag por byug go// bsham pa'i tshul ni/ par khang gi kha khyer la dug shing gi rtsang nyer gcig stod smad gri khrag dang mtshal gyis dmar po/ sked pa ro sol gyis nag por byugs pa srin mo'i 'gros su btsugs// par khang nang du lhung bzed kha gyen la phyogs pa de'i steng du mchod rten bzhag /par khang gi phyogs gang du par kha gtad pa'i phyogs de nyid shar du byas pa'i stegs bu'i byang shar sar 'khar gsil bsgrengs/

lhor phur pa dang mda' thun grogs kyi 'khar gsil rnams shing phur btab par bkal la bzhag /nub kyi stegs kyi khar snam sbyar/ po ti/ thub dbang gi sku rnams bzhugs pa'i mdun du ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa bshams| byang du thun rdzas lhag ma rnams bshams/ de rjes zla ba gang yang rung ba'i bdun gsum pa la bab pa'i tshe dkon mchog gi mchod pa/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum 'ur 'don rgyun pa dang*/ sātstsha dang chu gtor rang gi lo grangs sum 'gyur la sogs pa dang*/ dge 'dun la chos ston/ na raka skong bshags la sogs dam tshig gso ba'i cho ga dang dkar phyogs kyi rgyab brten ci 'grub dang*/ khyad par mgon po'i mnga' gsol dang*/ par khang klog pa la sogs zhag bdun las mi nyung bar 'bad do// yi ge brgya pa'i khrus dang*/ rang gi chos skyong srung ma/ yul lha/ phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa phyi nang gi srung ma rnams la gsol mchod gtor 'bul gshegs skyems la sogs pa mang du 'bul zhing rang ma nyes pa'i yus dang*/ dgras nyes pa byas pa bgrang zhing*| che ge mo 'dis sangs rgyas gyi bstan pa bshigs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad/ bla ma'i sku la bsdos/ gtsug lag khang dang*/ dge 'dun gyi gnas khang*/ dben ri gnyan po rnams bshigs/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor phrogs shing bcoms/ dam can srung ma khyod rnams la do bsdos/ rnal 'byor pa bdag la tho 'tsham/ mi dge bcu la spyad/ mtshams med lnga dang nye ba lnga byas/ bslu med rgyu 'bras khyad du bsad pa'i sdig po che/ che ge mo bya ba 'di las ngan 'khor ba'i rgyun bcad nas dag pa'i sa la gnas spor/ sha khrag dam can khyod rnams la tshogs kyi 'khor lor 'bul/ tshe bsod sngags 'chang bdag gi dpal du 'dod pa'i phyir drag po mngon spyod kyi las 'di lta bu brtsams pas/ de'i phyir rnal 'byor pa bdag gi mgon dang*/ rgyab rten dang*/ dpung gnyen dang*/ grogs dam pa mdzod la las 'di myur du sgrubs shig

/dam nyams 'di la srung skyob byed pa thams cad kyang sdig can 'di spongs shig /dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'o// bslu med rgyu 'bras kyi gshis sam babs so// rnal 'byor pa bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i bden pa'o// sa ma ya sa ma ya hoḥ /zhes dpang gzu drag po bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi nyams su blang ba la'ang gnyis/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa'o// dang po bsnyen pa la'ang gnyis/ rten bca' ba dang bsnyen pa dngos so// dang po rten bca' ba ni/ phyi nang gsang ba khyad par gyi rten no// phyi rten sngar bshad pa'i rta lug g.yag nag sogs la dar mthing nag dang rnga ma dmar nag gis brgyan/ mgon po lcam dral gyis drag sngags rnams dang rtsa ba'i bstod pa rnams gser ram mtshal gyis bris pa'i byang bu dri bzang dang dar snas dril ba mgul du btag /rang yi dam du bsgoms la/ mgon po lcam dral la bsngo zhing gdams/ nang rten ni par kha pa'i chas la bya ste/ gos nag gyon/ thod nag bcings/ dar nag gi ga sha dang se ral kha bya/ gdong nag por byugs| kha sha khrag gi sbags pa/ lag gnyis sha khrag gis bshal bar byas te zhe sdang drag po bskyed pa'o// gsang rten ni gri mda' rgod sgro ma de gri khrag gis dmar por byugs/ gri snying gi rtsa sbug dbus dmar mgon po lcam dral gyi srog snying byang sems dkar dmar dang gser dngul gyis bris pa bcug /rtse sbug g.yas su dri bzang dang dar sna/ g.yon du 'bru sna dang rin po che sna tshogs bcug /dar nag lcam dral gyi sku bris dang bcas pa mda' dar mgul du btags pa sku bris kyis g.yab/ khyad par gyi rten bla rdo ni/ mi bsad myong ba'i skyes dar ma mdog nag bongs thung gshis ngan pa zhig gis lho nub mtshams nas rdo nag po snying gi dbyibs can che chung go skabs dang bstun pas blangs ba dri bzang gi chus bkrus pa/ pho sems mo la chags pa'i phyir bu mo gtsang ma'i mngal khrag dang mtshal bsres nas mgon po lcam dral gyi sngags rnams dang*/

oṃ ma hā kā lā sa ma ya dgra bo st+waṃ bha ya sha trūṃ/ zhes pa rdo la bris pa ming po'i rten/ mo sems pho la chags pa'i phyir/ skyes dar ma phye bral dang mya ngan ma phog pa'i byang sems dkar po mtshal bsres pas dar nag la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mu khyud dang bcas pa bris pa'i rtsibs brgyad la/ ma ma/ traka raksha/ kha/ thun/ bhyo/ zhes pa 'bru re dang*/ lte bar/ sa ma ya sa ma ya rakṣantu/ zhes dang*/ mu khyud kyi phyi ma la/ oṃ ru ru/ ro ru ru/ bhe ta ti/ ba ro bi ru ru/ ro ru bhe ti/ st+waṃ bha to si/ rtsa la ag shug me/ zhes bri/ de yang sngags thams cad mgo phyir bstan g.yas skor du bris la/ de nyid thod pa'am lcags sder gtsang mar bcer ba'i steng du bla rdo bzhag /dar nag gi gur phub/ mgon po lcam dral bskyed bstim byas la zhag gsum du nyin pho sngags/ mtshan mo sngags/ de nas 'go 'khor lo bla rdo dril/ ma mos mgon po la 'khyud de snyoms 'jug gi bde ba bskyed par bsam/ de za 'og sna lngas dril la phyi phying pa nag pos btums/ sgrub pa'i dus rten gtor gyi steng du btsugs/ gzhan du rang lus la bcang bar bya'o// rten gtor ni/ nas| 'bras/ gro/ so ba/ sran ma/ bra bo/ ram pa/ yungs kar/ til rnams rjen phyer byas la rin po che sna tshogs pa brdar ba khrag chang gis sbrus pa'i bshos bu nag po stod zur smad zlum por byas pa khru gang la/ 'khor lha grangs dang mnyam pas bskor ba kha dog dmar nag tu bsgyur zhing rgyan ma btags pa snod bzang po gas chags med par bshams/ nang du lha rang rang gi sngags 'dod gsol dang bcas pa bcug pa par khang steng du dar nag gi gur phub la btags/ de'i 'og tu dug shog la liṅga ming rus bris/ dug khrag byugs pa kha sbub tu par khang steng du bla bres su bris pa nyin re bzhin bla 'gyu dus phur pa btab/ par khang gi nub phyogs su rgyu dang dbyibs snga ma lta bu'i mchod gtor rgyan dang ldan pa dar nag gi gdugs phub pa dang*/

las bdag pho mo'i gtor ma sha khrag gis brgyan pa dang*/ thun gtor rnams bshams/ logs shig tu bla ma/ yi dam/ mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong*/ gzhi bdag /yul lha/ lha srin sde brgyad dang bcas pa'i gtor ma rgyan dang ldan pa bshams/ gzhan yang khrag chen gyi arghaṃ/ dbang po lnga dang me tog nag po dang sha rus bdug pa'i me tog /a mṛ ta dang sha chen gu gul sbyar ba'i spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me mang po/ sha khrag dang dri bzang sbyar ba'i dri chab/ 'bru nag gi bshos bu khrag gis byugs pa'i zhal zas/ rkang gling thod rnga cha lang la sogs pa'i rol mo dang bcas pa bshams/ mchod rten nag po'i bum par/ munitruṃhūm̐/ zhes pa'i mtha' skor du mchod rten nag po 'di yi nang du yid la gnag pa'i dgra bo rnams mi rabs bdun rgyud tshun chad kyi dur thob cig /ces pa bris nas bcug /bang rim gnyis kyi mtshams su/ munishatruṃhūm̐/ zhes dang rten 'brel snying po bris pa'ang bcug /par bu'i nang gi mthil du la mtshal gyis truṃ/ de'i mthar yig mgo nang bstan du par bu'i nang du/ par bu nag po 'di'i nang du yid la gnag pa'i dgra bo 'di'i pha mes bdun rgyud bcas pa'i dur thob cig bris/ de'i phyir/ trakarakshathunabhyo/ trakaraksharbadabhyo/ trakarakshadaṃbhyo/ oṃ.āyuḥ.a/ samayathibs/ lingasharayadesod/ tsittasarbathibarbad/ ces rim pa gsum skor la bri'o// gnyis pa bsnyen pa dngos ni/ sgrub pa po rnams mtshams dam du bcad/ sgrub khang gi phyogs bzhir tho bzhi brtsegs pa rgyal chen bzhir mnga' gsol/ mchod bstod gtor ma phul la bar chad bsrung bar bka' bsgo/ cha gsum gtor ma btang*/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang nyid skad cig gis yi dam gyi lhar gsal bar gyur/ ces pa nas bzung bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa'i bar/ beng chen lcam dral gyi phrin las kyi rim pa dngos grub kun 'byung ltar grub rjes/ rtsa sngags dang*/ sha shog sbrel la ngag bcad dang bcas bzla'o// thun drug tu mchod bstod dang thun gtor 'bul/

dgong thun nam srod thun/ tshogs mchod/ mnga' gsol/ bskang bshags bya/ mtshan mo'ang thun bzung zhing sngags la 'bad pas bsgrub/ mchod bstod/ tshogs mchod/ mnga' gsol/ bskang bshags sogs kyi tshe gtor ma zur gsum rtse mo khrag gis byugs pa gsum re bshams| chang la a mṛ ta sbyar bas bran/ tshil chen kyi sdong bu mang po bshos bu de gsum la sbar/ mi'i dbang po lnga sogs mthun pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dngos su gshom pa gal che'o// de ltar bsnyen cing 'grub pa'i rtags su sngags pa nag po dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ dge bshes dang*/ mi nag dang*/ bud med nag mo dang*/ mon mo kha khra can dang*/ bal mo glang zhon dang*/ bya nag /khyi nag /g.yag nag dang*/ dmag chas can dang*/ jo gdan phrag g.yon gyon pa'i tshogs la sogs pa/ rab dngos/ 'bring nyams/ tha ma rmi lam du 'byung bas/ de dag chos skyong yin min brtag ces 'byung bas/ de dag chos skyong yin min brtag pa'i phyir/ gu gul/ yungs kar/ a mṛ ta/ gri khrag /sha chen/ rang ngam sngags pa nus ldan gyi gzhi rnams mnyam du sbyar la bsregs/ dkon mchog dang chos skyong la mchod pa rgya chen po bshams la gsol ba drag tu btab pas chos skyong gi rtags yin na je gsal je brtan du 'gro/ bgegs dang bar gcod kyi rtags yin na med nas 'gro ba yin no// de ltar mi 'gyur ba'i rtags lan gsum sogs byung nas sgrub pa brtsam par bya'i/ lha ma grub par las sbyor byas kyang rang la ldog gam ngal ba don med yin pas so// gnyis pa sgrub pa bsgrub pa la gsum/ thog mar bya ba/ bar du bya ba/ tha mar bya ba'o| |dang po thog mar bya ba la'ang gsum/ kha sbyor dbye ba/ thun rdzas rab gnas bya ba/ par kha bsdam pa'o// dang po kha sbyor dbye ba ni/ shug pa'i byang bu dkyus mtho gang ngam 'khyud mkhyid gang*/ zheng sor chen lnga tsam yod pa liṅga'i dpral bar rus/ bla la bla dwags/ tshigs chen bzhir/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

mthil bzhir/ mā ra ya rbad/ snying khar/ nṛ tri dang ming rus bris par dgra'i zag rdzas me la bsregs pa byugs/ par khang gi nub byang du lha dbye'i khang pa gru gsum pa rgya dang dpangs su rkang gang re yod pa sgo chung gcig dang bcas pa gzhan du mi 'chor ba'i zhal ba byas pa/ de'i nang gi sum gnyis mar bcad/ sum gcig yar bcad pa'i sar se ba'i ldom bu gnyis pa zhig bya/ byang bu de rang gi mdun du bklag thabs su bzhag /rang yi dam dang*/ mdun du mgon po lcam dral las bdag pho mo 'khor dang bcas pa gsal gdab spyan drangs nas bstod pa'i bar byas rjes drag tu bskul zhing*/ rang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pa mdun gyi mgon po la phog pas lcam dral 'khor bcas pho nya lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu thogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams gang ba spros/ dmigs pa'i dgra bo de nyid lcags kyus snying nas bzung*/ zhags pas ske nas khrid/ lcags sgrog gis yan lag bsdams/ dril bus myos su bcug ste byi'u khras ded pa'am/ sbur ma rlung gis bdas pa ltar mdun gyi byang bu dgra bo dngos su gsal ba de la bstim par bsam la/ dgug gzhug drag po brgya phrag gam nyer gcig yan chad byas rjes/ dgra bo che ge mo nṛ ā karṣa ya dza dzaḥ aṅku sha dza dzaḥ zhes brgya stong bzlas ma thag |lha dbye khang pa'i se ldom gyi 'og tu sol me ran tsam blugs/ se ldom gyi steng du byang bu kha sbubs mgo rang la bstan/ me steng lham gog /khyi lud/ ra ru/ mu zi nag po/ gu gul nag po sngags ma btab pa/ rta bong yug ma mdze skra rnams blugs| sgo chung dam par bcad/ du ba phyir mi 'chor ba'i lag tshags dam du byas la/ traka raksha khaṃ khaṃ/ 'bum 'bum/ sha ta te shaka/ ces drag tu brjod pa'i mthar/ dam nyams sdig po che 'dis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshigs/ zhes pa nas/ khyad du bsad pa'i sdig po che zhes pa'i mthar/ dgra bo che ge mo gzugs liṅga dang ming yi ger btab pa 'di pho lha dang phrol zhig

/pho 'dre dang sprod cig /yul lha dang phrol zhig /yul 'dre dang sprod cig /srog lha dang phrol zhig /srog bdud dang sprod cig /zhang lha dang phrol zhig /zhang 'dre dang sprod cig /ma lha dang phrol zhig /mo 'dre dang sprod cig /bang lha dang phrol zhig /bang 'dre dang sprod cig /rig 'dzin srung ma dang phrol zhig /ban bon srung skyob byed pa'i lha thams cad gshed du phob cig /ces dmod mo tshar bdun sogs drag tu brjod/ de rjes sho rde'u dkar nag bkram/ snam ras dkar po'i steng du rde'u dkar po spungs/ re nag gi steng rde'u nag po'i spungs/ rin po che'i snod gas chag med par dri bzang po dang 'o mas sbags pa'i chu blugs/ rdza khog gi nang du khrag gis sbags pa'i dug chu blugs/ rang ma nyes pa'i shags re re bsgrags shing rde'u dkar po re dri bzang gi chu nang du dor/ dgra'i nyes pa re re nas bsgrags shing rde'u nag po re dug chur bskyur/ de ltar grub nas rdel dkar dri bzang dang bcas pa rang gi khang steng du phos/ rdel nag dug chu dang bcas pa lha dbye khang pa'i steng ngam chu gzhung du dor/ de ltar 'gugs pa nas bzung sho rdel dgram pa'i bar nyin thun gsum/ mtshan thun gsum sogs byas pa zhag nyer gcig sogs su byas shing*/ thun mtshams rnams su bskul ba dang bcas drag sngags la 'bad pa'i rtags byang bu rang bzhin du gas na mchog tu bzang*/ gzhan yang dgra dngos su bkug pa dang*/ byang bu 'gul ba dang*/ khra spyang sogs kyis srog chags ded pa dang*/ bla bkuug pa sogs kyi rtags brtan po ma byung gi bar du 'bad pa gal che/ lar bsad las myur du brtsam pa las 'gugs rtags ma thon bar du bya ba gal che ba yin no// de ltar 'bad pas 'gugs dbye grub pa'i rtags brtan po lan gsum yan chad bya ba'o// gnyis pa thun rdzas rab gnas bya ba ni/ sgrub pa po thams cad chas gos nag po sogs gsang rten gyi skabs ltar bya/

sngo dmar shi skra'i byad thag gsum sgril 'dom gang tsam yod pa ming byang gi sker btags pa'i sne par kha bas bzung*/ gzhan rnams kyis mchod rten/ par bu/ snam sbyar/ 'khar gsil/ phu dung*/ mchog phur la sogs pa'i thun rdzas rnams lag tu thogs/ thams cad kyis spang skong sogs chos rnams rgyab tu khur nas lho zur du rim pas 'khod nas par khang la chos skor gsum byas nas dkon mchog dang mgon po lcam dral la mchod bstod dpang gzu drag po bya/ dgra'i le lan dang la yog brdar la thams cad kyis par khang la bon skor lan gsum byas la par khang de gshin rje'i pho brang lcags kyi khang sgrom me 'bar ba mdog nag cing mi sdug pa 'jigs su rung ba mthong ba tsam gyis ya nga ba dran pa tsam gyis skyi g.ya' ba 'og mtha'i rgya mtsho la thug cing*/ las kyi rlung dmar sho sho zer zhing rbud pa der tshud nas thar thabs med pa zhig tu bsams la/ par khang kha nas ming byang gi ske la btags pa'i byad thag liṅga'i nṛ mig tu drangs nas ming byang dong du bskyur te bklag thabs su bzhag /byad thag gi sne mo yar drangs pa 'dzab khung gi lho zur du yar drangs/ par kha bas mchod rten thogs la/ mchod rten nag po de nyid kyi bum par mu ni truṃ yod pa las 'od zer 'phros pas de nyid 'od kyi gong bu dmar nag mi sdug par gyur/ yang de las 'od 'phros pas 'og min na shākya thub pa bzhugs pa'i thugs kar phog thugs rgyud bskul bas shāka thub kyi sku gnyis pa zhig spros/ 'od kyi gong bu dmar nag de la thim pas mchod rten nag po ri rab ltar che la brjid pa zhig tu bsams la/ liṅga'i steng du mgo mjug ma log par bzhag ste/ mnan ling dgra bo dngos su gsal ba la bshan pas bshas lug gi gnya' ba la zhon pa ltar dgra bo 'gul 'khyug med par mnan par bsam/ dbyar yin na khyi lce nag po'i me tog /dgun yin na bra nag gam/

sran nag la rten 'brel snying po nyer gcig yan chad bzlas pa mchod rten sogs thun rdzas thams cad la gtor bas de dag thams cad gdug pa'i rdzas su grub par bsam/ de nas par kha bas par bu thogs la/ par bu'i nang gi liṅga truṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ par bu 'od dmar nag gi gong bur gyur/ slar de las 'od 'phros pas 'og min na shākya thub pa bzhugs pa'i thugs kar phog thugs rgyud bskul bas sku gnyis las spros pa'i 'od dmar nag gi gong bu la thim pas 'od de nyid gshin rje'i mun khang dgu rim nag po 'jigs su rung ba zhig tu gyur par bsam la/ rten 'brel snying po dang me tog 'thor/ traka raksha thun bhyo/ traka raksha rbad bhyo/ traka raksha daṃ bhyo/ oṃ ā yuḥ.a/ sa ma ya thibs/ ling shar ya de sod/ tsitta sarba thib rbad/ ces bzla zhing par bu kha sbub mchod rten gyi mgo la g.yogs pas dgra'i dbang po thams cad nyams shing dran pa 'thib par bsam mo// gsum pa par kha bsdam pa ni/ dur rdo gru gsum pa gsum gyi 'dzab khung gi zur par bus ma slebs pa rnams su rtse mo thur la bstan pas dgag /byad thag drangs pa ma gtogs/ mar me'i gdong rlung rgyu ba'i gseng sruub spu tsam med par dug khrag dang bag zan bsres pa'i 'jim pas legs par bkag ste/ slar phu dung las 'od zer 'phros 'od dmar nag tu gyur pa sogs mchod rten dang par bu'i skabs ltar la/ gdug pa'i thun rdzas su grub par bsam la rten 'brel snying po bzla me tog nag po 'thor/ par bu'i steng du bkab pas dgra bo dran pa 'thib cing myos par bsam/ yang snam sbyar la yang 'od zer spro bsdu dang rab gnas gong bzhin byas la phu dung gi steng du bltabs la bzhag /'khar gsil gyi rtse la yi ge ni nag po gsal ba las 'od 'phros/ gong ltar spro bsdu byas pas gdug pa'i rdzas kha ṭwāṃ ga nag po rtse gsum par gyur par bsam la/ me tog dor rten 'brel snying po bzlas 'dzab khung gi lho zur gyi g.yon du bsgrengs la gzugs/

de'i rwa bar du byad thag drangs la mchog phur la btags te mchog phur 'khar gsil gyi rtsar 'dzab khung gi lho zur du btsugs/ rab gnas gong ltar byas pas gdug pa'i rdzas rno dbal ngar dang ldan pa'i phur pa grub pa bsam/ mda' ltong las yi ge shaṃ nag po las 'od zer spro bsdu sngar ltar dang rab gnas byas pas tsandan gyi beng chen rab tu 'bar bar gyur par bsams la mchog phur gyi g.yas su gzugs/ de nas par bu'i khar sher phyin gyi po ti dang ston pa'i sku gzugs bzhag la mnan no// gnyis pa bar du bya ba par bu skor ba la bzhi/ yi dam gyi thun/ ming po'i thun/ sring mo'i thun/ las bdag dang 'khor gyi sil thun dang bzhi'o// de yang nyin gung*/ mtshan gung*/ nyi nub/ nyi shar te thun bzhir bdag bskyed gzhung bsrang ba dang*/ bzlas pa'i bar bsnyen pa'i skabs ltar la/ sha shog nyid bzla zhing dgug gzhug drag po gsum yan chod bya/ bden pa brdar/ rang ma nyes pa'i dpang gzu dang kho yi nyes pa bsgrags/ de rjes chas gos dang gsung rab khur ba sogs sngar rab gnas kyi skabs ltar thams cad kyis byas la/ dang po yi dam gyi thun rdeg pa ni/ thams cad par khang gi byang phyogs su bsgrengs la/ par kha bas 'khar gsil gyi rting par bu la gtad/ gzhan rnams kyis sku gzugs dang bsil thun rnams thogs la ngag tu/ chos rnams rgyal 'gyur chos min rgyal mi 'gyur// dge 'dun rgyal 'gyur mu stegs rgyal mi 'gyur// bdag cag rgyal 'gyur dgra rnams rgyal mi 'gyur// chos la dgra byung sangs rgyas ra mdar sdongs// zhes dbyangs dang bcas lan gsum gyer rjes/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal bar bsgoms nas par khang la phyag gsum btsal bas/ dgra des dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam gyi zil dang nus pa ma bzod par spyi bo dang rkang mthil shags kyis gas par bsam/ chos skor lan gsum bya/ yi dam gyi snying po dang*/ sher phyin gyi snying po dang*/

mgon po lcam dral gyi drag sngags sbrel nas bzla zhing*/ thun rdzas rnams mtshon cha sna tshogs dang nad yams thog ser du gyur pa dgra'i steng du phab pas dgra de thal ba'i rdul du brlag par bsam la sil thun gyis brdeg /yang phyag gsum chos skor gsum thun brdeg /yang phyag bskor gsum gsum dang thun rdeg pa ni gong ltar bya/ de ltar yi dam gyi thun la phyag dgu chos skor dgu/ thun rdeg thebs gsum bya ba yin no// gnyis pa ming po'i thun gsum ni/ bdag mdun gnyis ka mgon por bskyed/ mchod gtor phul/ chas sogs gong lta bus par khang gi lhor phyin la/ hūm̐ */ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas| |shin tu mi bzad gtum chen rngam pa'i sku// dbu skra ral pa kham nag gyen la 'khyil// sku la smug nag 'bar ba'i ber chen gsol// phyag na be con dmar po bsnams pa ni// dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod pa'i dgra bo la// gsor zhing gsor zhing klad pa'i rgyas su 'debs// mi nad sna dgu dgra la gtong ba'i phyir// lcam dral gnyis med thabs cig da tshur byon| |thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces bskul la/ bdag mdun gnyis ka mgon por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas las mgon beng dang*/ rdo rje'i tho ba dang*/ gtun shing dang*/ be con dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ ga dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ ral gri dang*/ dgra sta la sogs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros pas dgra bo de bsgral nas thal ba'i rdul du brlags par bsam/ bdag mgon por gsal bas phyag gsum btsal bas/ dgra des dkon mchog gi bden pa dang*/ mgon po'i mthu rtsal ma thub par tshal tshal shags shags gas shing dum bur gyur par bsam/ mda' dar g.yas su thogs la bon skor gsum bya/ gong ltar dmigs shing ngag tu/ sha shog /her ni shog /her ma thuṃ/ ril shog /der shog /'dir shog /'dir thuṃ/ 'dir thuṃ/ tsitta baṃ/ tsitta rbad/

ces bzla zhing mda' thun par bu la brdeg /yang gong ltar phyag gsum skor ba gsum dang mda' thun brdeg /yang phyag skor gsum gsum dang mda' thun brdeg /de ltar mda' thun la phyag dgu skor ba dgu/ thun rdeg thebs gsum mo// de bzhin du phyag gsum bon skor gsum snam sbyar thogs la/ sha shog gi mthar/ ma hā kā lā dgra bo ya to ya phaṭa ya to ya khug /che ge mo drung phyung rtsad chod/ ces snam sbyar gyis par bu la brdab/ yang phyag gsum bon skor gsum snam sbyar brdab/ de ltar snam sbyar gyi thun la phyag skor dgu dgu thun rdeg thebs gsum mo// yang 'khar gsil thogs la/ phyag skor gsum dang bon skor gsum dang*/ sha shog gi mthar/ ni ka ta ya ni ka ta ya/ trag raksha kha munt+ra kha thuṃ kha thuṃ nṛ rbad nṛ dzaḥnṛ dzaḥ dgra bo che ge mo'i mi nor drung phyung rtsad chod/ ces 'khar gsil gyi rting pas par bu la brdeg /yang phyag gsum bon skor gsum 'khar gsil brdeg /yang phyag skor gsum gsum dang 'khar gsil brdeg /de ltar 'khar gsil gyi thun la phyag skor dgu dgu thun rdeg thebs gsum/ des ni ming po'i thun la phyag nyer bdun/ skor ba nyer bdun/ thun rdeg thebs dgu 'gro'o// gsum pa sring mo'i thun gsum ni/ bdag mdun gnyis ka lha mor gsal zhing mchod gtor 'bul/ ngag tu/ bhyoḥ nam mkha'i dbang mo dbyings phyug ma// mkha' la 'phyo ba'i glog ma sprin// sku ni srin mo gshegs pa 'dra// zhal ni zla ba tshes pa 'dra// spyan ni rgyal skar shar ba 'dra// tshems ni spu gri gtams pa 'dra// mi lpags stong gi slog pa gsol| |g.yas na gser gyi phreng ba 'dzin// g.yon na nad kyi rkyal pa 'dzin// dam nyams dgra la nad yams 'bebs// chibs su rnga mo gwa pa bcibs// stong gsum kun tu rgyug 'dral byed// ma bdud chen mo gshegs su gsol// dpal gyi lha mo zhes kyang bya// bzhugs ni dkor khang dag la bzhugs// dgra bgegs gang yin srog tshur drongs// zhes bskul lo| |bdag lha mor gsal ba'i mthu byin dgra bos ma bzod par tshal par gas par bsam/

phyag gsum bon skor gsum/ thun lha mo bdag mdun lha mor gsal ba las rang 'dra ba'i lha mo/ mchog phur/ phu dung*/ zor ba thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros| dgra'i spyi bo nas rkang mthil bar gshags tshal dum bur gtub pa'i sha rus don snying thams cad mgon po lcam dral gyis hab sha thob sha byas nas dmar tsir tsir chem chem khruṃ khruṃ gsol bar bsam la g.yas su phu dung thogs la/ traka raksha sha ta hri traka raksha ba ri bhyo ma rang gi snying la duṃ duṃ/ dgra bo mi nor rtsad chod drung phyung*/ zhes phu dung gis par bu la brdab// yang phyag gsum bon skor gsum phu dung brdab/ yang phyag dang bon skor gsum gsum gyis par bur phu dung brdab/ de ltar phu dung la phyag dgu skor ba dgu thun rdeg thebs gsum mo// yang mchog phur thogs te/ mu na raksha dza mu na kha bya rbad/ mu na raksha rbad rbad dza dzaḥ dgra bo che ge mo'i mi nor rtsad chod drung phyung*/ zhes phyag gsum bon skor gsum/ mchog phur gyis par bur brdeg /yang phyag gsum bon skor gsum mchog phur brdeg /yang phyag dang bon skor gsum gsum dang mchog phur brdeg /de ltar mchog phur la phyag dgu skor ba dgu thun rdeg thebs gsum mo// slar yang phu dung thogs la/ traka raksha kha thuṃ thuṃ rbad rbad dza dzaḥ che ge mo'i mi nor rtsad chod drung phyung*/ zhes phyag gsum bon skor gsum phu dung par bu la brdab/ yang phyag gsum bon skor gsum phu dung brdab/ yang phyag skor gsum gsum phu dung brdab/ de ltar yang phu dung la phyag dgu skor ba dgu thun rdeg thebs gsum ste/ sring mo'i thun la'ang phyag nyer bdun/ skor ba nyer bdun/ thun rdeg thebs dgu 'gro'o// bzhi pa las bdag dang 'khor gyi sil thun ni/ par khang gi lho nas phyag gsum dang bon skor gsum bya/ yungs kar sogs sil thun rnams thogs nas/ oṃ ma hā kā lā kā la rū pa ā karṣa ya dza dzaḥ

sha shog /her ni shog /her ma thuṃ/ ril shog /'dir shog |'dir thuṃ/ 'dir thuṃ/ tsitta baṃ/ tsitta rbad/ ma hā kā lā ya to ya phaṭa/ ya to ya khug /ni ka ta ya/ ni ka ta ya/ bhe dze bhe dze/ saṃ bhe dze saṃ bhe dze/ traka raksha sha ta hri/ traka raksha rakmo/ mu na raksha dzaḥ mu na kha bya rbad/ traka raksha kha thuṃ kha thuṃ/ rbad rbad/ dza dzaḥ che ge mo'i mi nor rtsad chod drung phyung*/ zhes brdeg /yang phyag gsum bon skor gsum thun rdeg thebs gcig /yang phyag skor gsum gsum dang thun rdeg thebs gcig ste/ sil thun la phyag skor dgu dgu thun rdeg thebs gsum rigs 'gre/ de rjes 'gug gzhug drag po lan gsum yan chad byas rjes rdzas rnams par bu'i steng dang rang rang gi gnas su bkod la bzhag /de ltar thun bzhi byas rjes thun re re la yi dam gyi thun gcig /ming po'i thun gsum/ sring mo'i thun gsum/ sil thun dang rnam grangs brgyad yod par thun re rer phyag bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ skor ba phyi nang bsdoms bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ thun rdeg thebs nyi shu rtsa bzhi re byas pa ni gong ma dag gi phyag len yin la/ rgya gzhung dang sgrub thabs snga ma bzhi por thun bzhi po bsdoms par phyag skor brgya dang drug cu rtsa brgyad re/ thun rdeg thebs lnga bcu rtsa drug re bya bar bshad kyang*/ bla ma gong ma dag gi phyag len la snga ma kho na ltar bzhed pa yin no// de ltar thun bzhir phyag skor dang thun rdeg pa dang*/ thun mtshams rnams su sha shog gi bzlas pa dang*/ 'gugs 'dren la 'bad pa'i rtags ni/ sems can bsad bzung byas te sha khrag dang nang khrol bgos shing longs spyod pa dang*/ mkhar khang bshigs pa dang*/ shing bcad pa dang*/ me bsad pa dang*/ chu sgyur ba dang*/ sgrub khang tshig pa dang*/ par khang du 'khun pa 'debs pa/ 'od dang*/ rdeg chom/ mi nag /a tsa ra/ ban chen/ bon chen/ stag shar/ bud med chas bzang dang*/ bya nag /khyi nag la sogs pas dgra bo dngos su khrid pa dang*/

mgo lag glo snying ster ba la sogs pa rab dngos/ 'bring nyams/ tha ma rmi lam du yang yang 'byung zhing bstan pa dang*/ dngos nyams rmi lam du dgra bo med par byas zin to zhes dang*/ khyod kyi las byas zin to zhes zer ba sogs yid ches gdeng khel gyi mtshan rtags 'byung bar 'gyur gyi/ nang rtags yid ches gdeng khel lan gsum yan chad ma byung bar las kyi mtha' brtul yang rang nyid ngal la phyi rtags dgra la mi 'ong zhing*/ gzhan gyi grags pa ngan pa 'byung ba sogs skyon mang ba yin no// mtshan rtags yid ches thob nas/ gsum pa tha ma'i bya ba/ dam bca' ba ni/ sgrub po rnams chas sogs rab gnas kyi skabs ltar la/ par khang bas par khang gi steng du bsgrengs ba'i rkang pa g.yon pas par bu mnan/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pos/ ngag tu/ hūm̐ */ sdig can ming ni che ge mo// 'di nas dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong 'og /gshin rje'i rgyal pos chos 'chad zer// khyod kyi chos skal de na yod// de ru song la chos nyon cig /steng gi phyogs su ma ldog cig /bka' dang dam la ma 'da' zhig /gal te dam las 'das gyur na// bskal pa gcig tu dmyal bar ltung*// byang chub mchog gi sems bskyed nas// gnas ngan de las thar bar 'gyur// lan gsum dbyangs dang bcas pas brjod/ gsum pa mjug mtha' rgyas kyi bsdu ba la gsum/ bsgral zhing gnas spor ba/ las kyi mtha' gtugs pa/ ma 'chun zhing gtugs na gzir ba'o// dang po bsgral zhing gnas spor ba ni/ par bu rang gi yig cha rnams su dam tshig bstsal ba'i rjes su byang bu mi bsad pa'i mtshon nam sta re la sogs pas zhib tu bsres te dgra bo'i sha khrag rus par bsams la sreg pa tsam gsungs pa de tsam gyis kyang dgos pa skabs don gyi 'bras bu 'byin mod kyi/ gnas spor gyi cho ga ma byas na rang nyid rnam smin che bas/ bsgral las tshul mthun byas na drag po mngon spyod kyi gzhung chen rnams kyi dgongs pa dang mi 'gal zhing rnam dpyod kyi zur thon la nyams dod par 'gyur bas na/

dam bstsal ba'i mod der par bu bkog mchod rten gyi 'og nas byang bu tshur phyung lcags snod du phung re'i gdan la mgo rang la phyogs par gan rkyal du bzhag /mchod rten 'dzab khung du bcug /par bu g.yogs phu dung snam sbyar la sogs pa bkab la bzhag go// de nas byang bu kha khebs bsal nas dgug gzhug gsum sogs byas rjes yungs kar sogs sil thun rnams thogs nas yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ hūm̐ */ nga ni dpal chen he ru kaḥ /ma hā kā lā nga yi bran// zhes pa nas/ ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐/ zhes gtun rdung gi bar gtor zlog bar chad kun sel dkyus ltar bya/ gnyis pa las kyi mtha' brtul ba la gsum/ sreg pa/ mnan pa/ 'phang ba'o// dang po sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ par khang gi lhung bzed dang mchod rten tshur bzhag nas/ par khang de nyid du dug shing dang tsher ma can gyi shing gi hom bya/ sreg rdzas gta' gtor/ dus gtor/ thang khrom/ sha rus kyi dum bu rnams ming byang dum bur byas pa dang sbrags shing tsha ba'i mar khu dang bcas pa sreg rdzas byas la/ phaṭaḥ thab khung me rab tu 'bar ba drag po chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po zhes pa nas/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba'i sbyin sreg gtor zlog bar chad kun sel dkyus ltar bya'o// gnyis pa mnan pa ni/ sbyin sreg gi thal sol rnams dang*/ gsar du liṅga zhig bris par zag rdzas byugs la 'gugs dbye byas te bltabs la shi skra dang sngo dmar gyis bcings pa dang*/ mchod rten dang bcas pa dur khrod la sogs pa mnan pa'i sar shis par byin la/ gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin nas/ dgra bo che ge mo 'di'i dur 'dir 'debs pas/ khyod rnams kyis bdag gi grogs gyis dang*/ las 'di grub pa dang gtang rag bzang po ster ro// zhes brjod/ der dong gru gsum brus la/ rang yi dam gyi mdun du mgon po lcam dral bskyed mchod bstod phrin bcol gsol kha sogs las gzhung ltar bya/

de rjes dpang gzu sogs kha sbyor dbye ba'i skabs ltar byas la/ dgra bo che ge mo 'di'i dur gnas dong 'di'i nang du thob cig /ces sogs dmod bcol drag po bya/ dong de sngar gyi par khang ltar lcags kyi khang sgrom sogs su bskyed nas nang du dgra'i dur btab pa legs par thebs par bsams la/ liṅga bcug pa'i steng du sbyin sreg gi thal sol btab/ de'i steng ro g.yam la steng ri rab 'og rgya gram bris pas mnan/ 'byung ba dgra gshed kyis brub pas dam du dgag /de'i khar ri rab kyi steng du chos skyong gi pho brang btab pas dgra bskal pa'i mthar yang mi thar bar bsams la las bzhi'i bro brdung ngo*// gsum pa 'phang ba ni/ rten gtor sil thun lhag ma rnams bskul drag po dang bcas pas dgra bo'i phyogs su zor 'phang ngo*// bris sku brdab/ dmod pa bor/ de nas sgrub khang nang du 'ongs la gtor ma'i lhag rol la sogs pa rnams dang*/ gsar du bshams pa'i gtor mchod rnams bsnyen pa'i skabs ltar 'bul zhing mnga' gsol bya/ brtan ma bskyangs shing par bskang 'don/ de nas zhag bdun gyi ring la bshags pa dang bskang ba 'don pa spang skong bklag /mchod gtor rgya chen po 'bul/ sātstsha gdab/ gsung rab sgrog /tshogs 'khor bya/ gzhan yang dpung 'bul du dge ba'i las 'grub tshad 'bad nas bya/ de nas khad kyis mtshams grol zhing phyogs mdog bzhi'i rgyal tho la gtang rag phul gshegs/ sgrub khang steng du bsang mchod la sogs pa bya'o// de ltar nor 'khrul med par 'bad pas bsgrubs pa'i rtags dgra la mi 'byung mi srid do// yang de an tsam las 'gyang na tshan che/ de ma thag myur du rtags byung na cung tshan chung ba yin no// de ltar sgrub pa'i ring sgrub khang du 'od dkar la 'khyug pa byung na mtshams bton/ 'od zla tshes lta bu byung na chang phud gtor zhing dmod bcol bya/ 'od smug po byung na mgon po'i nga rgyal ma yeng ba'i ngang nas rbad sngags drag tu bzla/

'od dmar nag byung na grib ngo yin pas bshags pa bya/ 'od dmar po 'phro zhing par bu 'tshag na las grub pas dgra la dus btab cing chos skyong la btang rag btang ngo*// de ltar byas kyang rtags ma byung ba'am/ mi 'grub pa'i rtags snying mi dga'/ 'dug mi 'dod cing 'jigs snang 'byung ba/ nad drag pos btab bam/ khro snying 'dod/ snying mi dgrar ldang*/ grogs la sogs pa phyir gyes/ sgrub po rnams nang 'thab/ khyad par du par bu kha gyen la bzed la 'dug pa dang*/ byang bu dong nang du kha sbub tu 'gyel ba dang*/ dpon slob zhe 'khon zhugs pa dang*/ mtshams pas bud med ded cing mtshams la har 'don byas pa dang*/ dgra yis gtor ma bsngos pa la sogs pa byas nas de'i rkyen gyis dgra mi sod cing rang la ldog pa la sogs pa nyes 'gyod sna tshogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro// de ltar mi legs shing ldog pa'i rtags mthong na/ gsum pa ma 'chun zhing 'khu ldog pa dang*/ las brtul na par bu'i kha 'ching zhing mgon po gzir zhing gnad la dbab pa ni/ zangs dang lcags la sdig pa'i gzugs re re byas pa'i bar du mgon po lcam dral las bdag dang bcas pa'i gzugs kyi khong par rang rang gi srog sngags bris pa bstim/ sdig pa gnyis lto sbyar dar nag gis dril la rang yi dam lha'i nga rgyal gyis sdig pa klad la bskor zhing mgon po lcam dral las bdag dang bcas pa'i sngags rnams las log drag por bzlas pas/ mgon po lcam dral las bdag dang bcas pa mgo 'khor khrag skyug 'dar yed yed da ni khyod kyi las bya'o ci bgyi sogs zer bar bsam/ dngos nyams rmi lam du skyes pa bud med nyams dma' bas bdag la 'dud pa sogs chos skyong gnad la bor ba'i rtags gzhan ltar byung ba dang*/ sdig pa'i bar gyi gzugs rnams phyung dri bzang dang 'o mas bkrus/ chos skyong gi sngags la yig brgya btags pas bzod par gsol/ mchod bstod/ mnga' gsol rgyas par byas rjes/

slar par bu'i bcas rnams gsar du bshams la/ sngon 'gro nas brtsams te sgrub pa lan gsum bskyal/ sngags nyin mtshan du sgra ma chad par bzla/ ting 'dzin gsal zhing mchod rdzas tshogs par byas la dam tshig gtsang ba'i grogs dang bcas bsgrubs na dgra la lcags kyi srog dgu sgril du yod kyang 'chad pa la the tshom med pa yin no// de ltar par bu kha 'ching zhing gzir ba dang gnad la dbab pa 'di ni dgos pa mi 'byung la/ gal te dgos pa byung na'ang yi dam dang chos skyong la bya ba byas pa'i rnal 'byor pa gdeng tshad dang ldan pa zhig gis bya yi| su rung gang rung gis byas na me lce'i kha la sbrang bu 'phur ba dang mtshungs so/ /smras pa/ ma gshin phur bu rdeg gshor rlung la sogs// drag po mngon spyod gzhung mang rtogs pa yi// bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo ngas// zhing bcu mgo snying tshal par dgas pa yi// gnam lcags thog mda' kha lor sgyur ba las// par bu nag po'i gdams pa bklag chog tu// smras so bstan dgra'i tshogs rnams bag yod bsten// kho bo dge sbyong tshul gyis drag po'i las// brtsam par mi 'os kyang ni rgyud rnams su// bstan la gnod byed bsgral bar gsungs pa rnams// gdug la byams na rtsa ltung bcu par gsungs// de phyir zhing bcur byams pa'i sems bskyed las// gnas ngan bsgral nas bde 'gror bkod pa yi// dkon mchog dbu 'phang mtho la bstan pa 'phel// sngags 'chang don grub dgra bgegs ngan song las// grol na dam chos nyams len 'di ngo mtshar// snyigs ma'i dus na chos bzhin spyod pa lta'i// bag tshul tsam gyis 'gro ba thabs kyis 'gugs// rkyen dang phrad na dug mtshon kha sbyor gyis// gzhan srog gcod la snyem pa mi mnga' yang*// ya mtshan can 'ga' mthong bas yid phyung ngo*// 'di dge'i gtum po'i 'od ltar rab dkar ba'i// rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' klong skyed tshal du// rdo rje khrag 'thung bde bas myos pa'i gar// sna tshogs bsgyur de 'gro bas kyang thob shog

/de ltar dpal ye shes kyi mgon po beng chen lcam dral las bdag dang bcas pa'i par bu nag po'i sgrub thabs gnam lcags thog mda' zhes bya ba 'di'ang jo gnubs chen po'i rigs las/ gdan sa chen po dpal byang chub gling gi chos sgo gdan sa las thog pa bla ma dkon mchog gis lha rdzas dag pa'i me tog dang bcas te nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ par bu nag po'i srog gi rgyud le'u bcu pa dang*/ las bdag pho mo'i par bu'i man ngag /gnyen shes rab yon tan gyis lho brag mkho mthing lha khang gi ka khong nas phyung ba dang*/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug kre bo rdo rje mgon pos mdzad pa'i par bu'i man ngag skor rnams dang*/ sngags 'chang 'od zer seṅges mdzad pa'i par bu nag po'i sgrub thabs gsal ba'i zhabs bsgrigs gsal ba'i sgron me sogs zab pa'i yig rnying mang po'i gnad bsdus te/ man ngag lag len bltas chog tu bkod pa 'di ni/ dbur stod 'bri klung du son pa skyu ra'i gdung las dus mtha'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa sngags 'chang thugs kyi rdo rje zhes sam/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa zhes 'bod pas/ me khams yal ga'i ri dwags kyi lo'i chu shel dbang po'i tha skar gyi dga' ma dang dga' mgur spyod pa'i dus la bab pa'i thabs kyi cha'i dga' ba gsum pa la dbur stod klung shod rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu mgyogs par sbyar ba re zhig go/ //maṅga laṃ//
